title: mcp: a pin for the dataset tools when the i18n service resolves but its reads throw
body:
epic:#34659#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnXJdSZifpEN5i7aU

Filing gate: ④ a child of the cross-lane parent #34659 (the 「MCP 二期与问数」 epic). The maintainer set who files this epic's cards, in this session's chat, 2026-11-17, verbatim: 「你应该负责立卡，对方只是派发处理」. The gap was reported to this session by the dispatching seat `repo:objectstack#3` on #34659 (comment 6948693475); the filer did not re-read the code behind it. Source: the L1 record on PR #34833, 6948646042, N3. Left open at landing under the maintainer's merge standard for nits.

## Why

When the i18n service is present but a read throws, the dataset catalogue degrades to untranslated text on both transports. That may be the right behaviour; nothing pins it, so a later change can turn it into a refusal or a silent wrong answer unnoticed.

## Evidence

- Per the report: no test covers an i18n service whose `getLocales` / `getTranslations` throws; the case reaches the dataset executor as a degraded read on HTTP and stdio alike.

## Scope

- One pin beside `stdio-data-bridge` in `packages/mcp/src/`, and the matching HTTP-door case if it is unpinned too: the read degrades, and says so the way the door's degradation rule requires.

## Done when

- Both pins are green and fail when the degraded read is removed.

## Relations

- Parent: #34659. Related: #34787 (PR #34833).
